protocol: R2-v1, frozen before initialization selection and ablation results
split_note: All seven belong to official training split and were used in previous pilot. This is a within-pilot held-out split for this round only; not independent scenes or official test.
initialization: Compare all 6 ordered subsets of 2 self/cross pairs from 4, plus full teacher; train split only, 512x256. Rank by number of usable frames (>=8 matches), then median GT rectified vertical error; no threshold tuning. If all fail, train-split teacher distillation.
ablation: Freeze selected matcher, cache 1024x512 descriptors/correspondences. Risk head: 120 Adam steps lr1e-4 on four train frames cyclic. Camera head: 120 Adam steps lr1e-4 with learned risk frozen. Five seeds. Report all 3 evaluation frames for all seeds.
metrics: Reference homography anchor error, separate GT-filtered SIFT row error, full-grid hard support, depth MAE on common reference-grid mask across methods for each frame/seed, coverage separately. Reference is offline-pose SGBM, not true depth.
decision: No claiming effectiveness from training loss or row shrinkage alone; report paired seed means and all failures. No full data download or original-table reproduction.
